'''Jonsior system''' was a [[star system]] located in the [[the galaxy]]'s [[Core Worlds]]. It was situated at grid square L-10 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> Transport to the system was available from the [[Coruscant Eastern Spaceport]].<ref name="Aldhani">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref>

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the Jonsior system was mentioned as "Jonsior" on a list of destinations in the Coruscant spaceport in "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]," the fourth episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''.<ref name="Aldhani" /> It was identified as a system in the appendix "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]," published with the [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="Appendix" /> on [[June 24]], [[2025]]. Both were written by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Substack">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/about-that-new-star-wars-galaxy-map|text=About That New Star Wars Galaxy Map…|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-06-24}}</ref> In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the [[moons of Jonsior]] were introduced in ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article from [[2009]].<ref name="Tinker">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>
